order_note: No predecessor and no order on this engine. SQL 142 (owner decision 2026-11-04, "Option 2": tenant admins may add and edit the shared mortgage company directory; a tenant admin's add or edit from Manager or a Loss Draft check answered rls_denied, production API log 2026-11-04T20:28:16Z) needs public.mortgage_companies with a boolean is_active, public.aws_is_tenant_manager_admin(), public.aws_is_authenticated(), public.aws_is_cross_tenant_reader() and the role authenticated (spec prerequisites). The applying login must own public.mortgage_companies (altered_relations_owned_by_login: CREATE POLICY needs the owner). The engine's read-only catalog counts must each be 1 before any apply: mortgage_companies_rls_enabled (an ordinary table with ROW LEVEL SECURITY enabled; file: sql142_table_missing, sql142_rls_disabled), mortgage_companies_is_active_boolean (file: sql142_is_active_missing), mortgage_companies_owner_policy_intact (aws_write_mortgage_companies PERMISSIVE FOR ALL TO exactly {authenticated} with USING and WITH CHECK aws_is_authenticated() AND aws_is_cross_tenant_reader(); file: sql142_owner_policy_missing, sql142_owner_policy_collision) and mortgage_companies_no_unexpected_policy (no policy other than aws_select_mortgage_companies, aws_write_mortgage_companies and the file's two; file: sql142_unexpected_policy); the file also raises sql142_function_missing without aws_is_tenant_manager_admin(). It creates two PERMISSIVE policies TO authenticated: aws_insert_mortgage_companies_tenant_admin FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (aws_is_tenant_manager_admin() AND is_active) and aws_update_mortgage_companies_tenant_admin FOR UPDATE USING / WITH CHECK (aws_is_tenant_manager_admin() AND is_active). Deactivating, reactivating and deleting stay with aws_write_mortgage_companies (platform owner only), which is not changed. The pre-state is derivable: both policies absent (ae3be52e6cdd57b9ba779e573a0e1cdab53c793a63893044fb124efbe81238f3, derived by aws/tests/release-sql142-executor.test.mjs and read back on PostgreSQL 16). If the read-only inspect finds both policies as intended it reports already_applied true and nothing is applied. Changes no other policy, grant, RLS flag, function, table, column or row; the API allowlist (write-allowlist.mjs) still decides which columns a write may carry.
